# ConPTY's license

`conpty.dll` and `OpenConsole.exe` ship beside `unifyterm.exe` on Windows. They come from the NuGet package `Microsoft.Windows.Console.ConPTY` (MIT, https://github.com/microsoft/terminal); `tools/fetch-conpty.ps1` downloads a fixed version into `vendor/conpty`, which git does not keep.

`LICENSE` here is that project's license text. `tools/notices.ps1` puts it at the top of `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES`.
